reason: The company is executing a share buyback at INR 900 per share, providing a floor and potential premium for existing shareholders.

source_headlines: Gandhi Special Tubes Limited: Gandhi Special Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Buyback- Update regarding the Buyback Offer of up to 8,68,100 fully paid-up Equity Shares of Face Value of Rs. 5/- each of Gandhi Special Tubes Limited ( the Company ) at a price of INR 900/- per Equity Share through tender offer route ( Buyback Offer ) -Copy of Letter of Offer and Tender Form
